baselineConfig.name: BM25 lexical baseline
baselineConfig.description: Frozen heuristic thresholds, not tuned on these case labels or a live run. Case-insensitive Unicode tokens, English stopword removal and conservative English suffix normalization; no embeddings or translation. Standard BM25 across combined public profile fields; maximum three candidates above evidence and relative-score thresholds.
